boundary: This manifest classifies data-source reachability, not presentation fidelity or per-action semantic compliance. A locked slot with unlock level zero is only promoted when a fail-closed original-ROM route proves its exact battle, variant, character, action, and unlocked state.

Not an unresolved external unlock: the original ROM synchronization function has an exact battle 31 variant 0 special case for Sasuke action 19. It changes the slot to state 0, after which normal training is still required.
